items.headline: Robinson, Wilder combine for 255 yards rushing and 3 scores to lead Southern Miss over UL Monroe
items.description: — Steven Robinson and Jamarice Wilder each ran for more than 100 yards and combined for three touchdowns to lead Southern Miss to a 35-21 victory over Louisiana-Monroe on Saturday.

items.headline: Louisiana-Monroe scores 18 points late, beats Troy 21-14 for first win of the season
items.description: — Aidan Armenta threw two touchdown passes for Louisiana-Monroe, and the Warhawks scored 18 points inside the final 3 minutes of the game to beat Troy 21-14 on Saturday for their first win of the season.
